test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a class, the average age of 28 boys is 23 years. Two boys whose ages are x years and 27 years leave the class. If the new average age of the class is 23 years, then what is the value of x ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the average remains unchanged after some members leave, the average of those who left must equal the initial average.

Average of 28 boys = 23

New average of 26 boys = 23 (No change)

⇒ Sum of ages of 2 boys who left = 2 × 23 = 46 years

⇒ x + 27 = 46 ⇒ x = 46 − 27 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Total boys = 28, Initial Average = 23 years, Ages of boys leaving = x and 27, Remaining boys = 26.

Formula: Total Sum = Average × Number of items

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af3326a9472bd8f12437b396bf0e3b0d70977c6642d3dc8f6b5a1bfa91289ea0.png] 

⇒ Total age of 28 boys = 28 × 23 = 644 years

⇒ Total age of 26 boys (after two leave) = 26 × 23 = 598 years

⇒ Sum of ages of the two boys who left = 644 − 598

⇒ x + 27 = 46

⇒ x = 46 − 27

⇒ x = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Change Rule

If the average remains constant after removal, the value of the removed item(s) must be equal to the average. Value = n × Average (where n is the number of items removed).

Effect of Departure on Average

If a person leaves and the average increases, the person's age original average.

Weighted Average Formula

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n represents counts and x represents individual averages.
